summary: Repeat review closed all five system findings and most backend findings, but found a lifecycle fence race plus retry-classification and required-Source-field gaps. Backend must return to code; the system lane has no blocking findings.
validation: System reviewer verified REV-SYS-001 through REV-SYS-005 closed at df298af
System reviewer confirmed durable queued build is the issue #28 boundary; provider/publication work belongs later scenarios
Backend reviewer verified prior replay-ID, OpenAPI, worker, and general retry/DLQ corrections, then inspected remediation race windows and schema completeness
blockers: Lifecycle resolution occurs outside the fence transaction and can enqueue stale pre-change inputs after a concurrent newer lifecycle event.
AmazonServiceException with Retryable=false is treated as transient and consumes retry budget before DLQ.
Producer-required track_generation, status, created_at, and artifact created_at remain nullable or unenforced in Source-event validation.
next_action: Return to backend code for bounded fence recheck/retry, exact AWS retry classification, complete required-field validation, and focused concurrency/negative tests; optionally add low-cost port ownership branch coverage.

issues.title: Lifecycle resolver can enqueue stale generation across fence race
issues.details: InvalidateGenerationAsync resolves active heads outside the transaction, then locks/increments the fence without proving the observed fence/head remained current. Capture and recheck fence and head identity around resolution, retry boundedly on change, and add a concurrent active-head test.

issues.title: AWS Retryable false is classified as transient
issues.details: KnowledgeEventRetryPolicy tests AmazonServiceException.Retryable for non-null rather than true. Require Retryable == true and cover true and false values so permanent S3 auth/validation failures do not masquerade as outages.

issues.title: Required Source snapshot fields remain nullable or unenforced
issues.details: Enforce producer-owned required track_generation, status, event created_at, and artifact created_at values before persistence/materialization, with missing/invalid negative tests.

issues.title: Port collision and foreign version ownership branches lack focused tests
issues.details: The nonce-backed bounded startup implementation is sound but collision retry and foreign /version rejection are exercised only indirectly. Add focused coverage if it remains low-cost; otherwise retain as residual test debt for parent #26.
